services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: We offer half, three-quarter, and full-day fishing charters for 1-2 anglers. All ages and experience levels are welcome. Captain Braden Powell is USCG licensed, fully insured, and is very well respected as a Charleston fly fishing guide & inshore charter captain. We work hard for clients, and want you to leave feeling excited about coming back again. Depending on your trip goals and timeframe, we’ll customize a fishing charter to meet your specific needs in the beautiful marshes of the South Carolina Lowcountry.
